title: Oncomine Focus Assay - Pt 4: Purify Library + Elution
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Add AMPure XP reagent
steps.instruction: For each sample column, use the P300 multi‑channel pipette with a fresh tip set to transfer 45 µL of Agencourt AMPure XP reagent from column 1 of the NEST 12‑well reservoir to the sample plate, mix 5 times, then discard the tips.

steps.title: Incubate without magnet
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 5 minutes with the magnetic module disengaged.

steps.title: Bind DNA with magnet
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module and incubate for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant (first)
steps.instruction: Using the P300 multi‑channel pipette with a fresh tip set, transfer 75 µL of supernatant from each sample column to column 11 of the NEST 12‑well reservoir, then discard the tips.

steps.title: Ethanol wash (first)
steps.instruction: For each sample column, transfer 150 µL of ethanol from column 3 of the NEST 12‑well reservoir to the sample plate, mix 5 times, then discard the tips.

steps.title: Incubate with magnet (first wash)
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module and incubate for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Remove ethanol supernatant
steps.instruction: Using the P300 multi‑channel pipette with a fresh tip set, transfer 150 µL of supernatant from each sample column to column 11 of the NEST 12‑well reservoir, then discard the tips.

steps.title: Second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the ethanol wash steps: add 150 µL ethanol from column 3 to each sample column and mix 5 times, engage the magnetic module and incubate 2 minutes, transfer 150 µL supernatant to column 11, then disengage the magnetic module.

steps.title: Dry beads incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 2 minutes with the magnetic module disengaged.

steps.title: Elute with Low TE
steps.instruction: For each sample column, transfer 50 µL of Low TE from column 5 of the NEST 12‑well reservoir to the sample plate, mix 5 times, then discard the tips.

steps.title: Incubate elution (no magnet)
steps.instruction: Incubate for 2 minutes with the magnetic module disengaged.

steps.title: Bind eluted DNA
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module and incubate for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Collect eluate
steps.instruction: Using the P300 multi‑channel pipette with a fresh tip set, transfer 50 µL of supernatant from each sample column to the next empty column of the empty NEST 96‑well PCR plate in slot 3, then discard the tips.
